node.subject: english
node.title: 阅读应用文: 通知
node.content_req: 在第二学段 (3~4 年级)教学情境中,能阅读通知。
key_points: 在第二学段 (3~4 年级)教学情境中
能识别通知的标志性开头 NOTICE 三个大写字母, 把它和普通文章区分开
通知包含时间、地点、事情三要素, 读通知只需抓住这三项关键信息
能跳过通知里的装饰词和废话, 直接捞出 2 o'clock 这类藏在长句中的关键时间
node.academic_req: 在阅读通知的语境中, 能识别 NOTICE 标识, 快速定位时间、地点、事项三要素, 准确获取活动信息。
node.assessment_prompt: 发一张写着 NOTICE 开头的小海报, 里面写周三下午两点去公园, {{name}}能不能一眼指出日期是 Wednesday, 地点是 park?\n故意把通知里的时间藏在一堆装饰词中间比如「清晨阳光明媚的周三下午两点」, {{name}}会不会跳过废话直接捞出 2 o clock 这个关键信息?\n让两个{{name}}一组, 一个写通知一个读通知, 读完的那个能不能准确说出要带什么、几点到、去哪里这三件事, 而不是漏掉其中一两件?

node.teaching_voice: 我们来看,通知长得就特别——顶上写着 NOTICE 三个大字母,一看就知道不是普通故事书。比如学校发'明天 2 o'clock 在操场开运动会',你不用读完整个句子,只要抓'2 点''操场''运动会'三件事。记住,读通知就像看快递单号,直接找时间、地点、干什么就行。

exercises.question: Look at this notice. What will happen at 3 o'clock? NOTICE The school picnic is on Friday at 3 o'clock in the afternoon. Please come to the big playground and bring some snacks.
exercises.explanation: 通知里时间是3 o'clock,地点是playground,事情是picnic,所以选A。B地点错,C事情错,D地点错。
options: A. Have a picnic at the playground.
B. Play games in the classroom.
D. Buy snacks at the shop.

exercises.question: Read the notice. Fill in the two key things. NOTICE The reading meeting is tomorrow at 10 o'clock in the morning in the school library. Don't forget to bring your book.
exercises.explanation: 通知三要素:时间是10 o'clock,地点是library,事情是reading meeting。只需填时间和地点两个空。

exercises.question: Look at this notice: NOTICE The art class is on Monday at 2 o'clock in the art room. Please bring your colour pencils. When and where is the art class?
exercises.answer: The art class is on Monday at 2 o'clock, in the art room.
exercises.explanation: 1. 抓时间:Monday 2 o'clock。2. 抓地点:art room。3. 事情是art class,答题里可以带上。答出时间和地点即可满分。

exercises.question:
Read the notice from Sunshine Primary School and answer the questions.

NOTICE

Dear students, we are excited to invite you to the school Art Festival! It will be held in the school hall on Friday, October 18th, from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Please bring your paintings or handmade crafts to show. Parents are welcome to join us. Don't forget to wear your school uniform. See you there!

(1) When is the Art Festival?
(2) Where will the Art Festival be held?
exercises.answer:
【审题】题干是一则学校艺术节通知,需要找出活动的时间(When)和地点(Where)。
【分析】通知的三要素是时间、地点、事情,本通知中时间藏在 from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. 这一长句里,地点藏在 in the school hall 中,需要跳过 "we are excited to invite you" "dear students" 这类装饰词,直接抓关键信息。
【解答】(1) The Art Festival is on Friday, October 18th, from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.(2) It will be held in the school hall。
exercises.explanation: 1. 正确识别 NOTICE 标志,知道这是通知而非普通文章。2. 能跳过邀请语等装饰词,准确定位时间信息(October 18th, 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.)。3. 能准确定位地点信息(in the school hall),完成两小问作答。

exercises.question:
Compare the two notices below and answer the questions.

Notice A:
NOTICE
Time: Monday, 9:00 a.m.
Place: Room 301
Thing: English speech contest

Notice B:
Dear classmates, I'm glad to tell you that our English speech contest will be on Monday at 9:00 a.m. in Room 301. Come and join us! It's a great chance to show your speaking skills.

(1) Both notices share the same three key pieces of information (time, place, thing). What are they?
(2) Which notice is a better example of a "real school notice"? Why? (Think about the three key elements: NOTICE marker, time/place/thing, and skipping extra words.)
exercises.answer:
【审题】两则通知包含相同的时间、地点、事情三要素,需要提取共有的关键信息,并评价哪一则更符合通知的典型特征。
【分析】本概念强调三点:①顶部 NOTICE 标志;②时间、地点、事情三要素;③读通知要跳过装饰词,直接抓关键信息。Notice A 顶部有 NOTICE,信息分三行排列,一目了然;Notice B 没有 NOTICE 标志,关键信息埋在长句里,需要跳过 "I'm glad to tell you" "It's a great chance" 等装饰词才能找到。
【解答】(1) The three key pieces of information are: Time – Monday, 9:00 a.m.; Place – Room 301; Thing – English speech contest。(2) Notice A is a better example of a real school notice. It has the big NOTICE marker at the top, and the three elements (time, place, thing) are listed clearly. Notice B buries the key information inside long sentences with extra polite words, so readers need to pick out the real message from the decorations. A real notice should make the three key points easy to find at first glance.
exercises.explanation: 1. 能从两则通知中分别准确提取时间(Monday 9:00 a.m.)、地点(Room 301)、事情(English speech contest)三要素。2. 能识别 Notice A 顶部的 NOTICE 标志,理解这是通知区别于普通文章的关键特征。3. 能辨析 Notice B 中 "I'm glad to tell you" "Come and join us" "It's a great chance to show your speaking skills" 等是装饰词/废话,关键信息藏在长句中。4. 综合判断 Notice A 更符合"通知长得就不一样、抓三要素就够"的特点,理由充分。
